# Three.js for the Ocean theme

Version: **0.187.0**, MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz

`three-ocean.module.js` is a local, minified ES-module bundle built from the official npm package with esbuild. `ocean-art-scene.js` loads it lazily for the Ocean hero's image-based painting animation. The earlier `ocean-scene.js` procedural background is retained as unused source. No runtime CDN or npm installation is required to serve this static site.
